AI Rap Video Ideas

Who are you making it for?

Pet Rap

For your dog, your cat, your hamster

  • “A tough bulldog roasts the humans who call him a good boy”
  • “A tabby cat shoves my coffee off the desk and feels no shame”
Make your pet rap

Roast & Diss Track

For teammates, roommates and coworkers

  • “Roast my Warzone teammate who blames lag for zero kills”
  • “Zoom calls, crashed Excel, and 'per my last email'”
Make a roast rap

Birthday Rap

For your bestie, your mom, your crew

  • “Roast my bestie on her 30th: one drink, then a nap”
  • “Thank Mom for 6 a.m. lunches and double shifts”

Christmas Rap

  • “Grandpa roasts the grandkids glued to their phones”

Make a Christmas rap

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I make a rap video?

Open the studio, pick a sample video, add your photo or use the sample one, describe your idea and choose a flow. AI writes four rhyming bars and plays them as a free 10-second rap preview. Like it? Click Generate Video to turn your photo into a 10-second vertical 1080p rap video. It uses credits and is saved to My Videos.

Can I use a photo of my pet or a character?

You can use a clear image that you own or have permission to use. For the free preview, the Match photo voice sends your photo to our AI provider to pick the voice; with any other voice, it stays in your browser.

Can I listen to an audio preview here?

Yes. The studio on this page writes your bars and turns them into a 10-second AI rap track, free and without an account. You can make up to 5 previews per day.

How long are the rap videos generated by RapAvatar?

Every RapAvatar video runs 10 seconds, vertical 9:16 at 1080p, and the free audio preview runs 10 seconds too. Longer videos and full-length songs are not available.

Is RapAvatar free to use? What is the pricing?

Audio previews are free without an account, up to 5 per day. Videos use credits: the Impulse Pack is a one-time $4.99 for 3 videos, Creator Monthly is $14.99 for 12 videos a month and Agency / Studio is $39.99 for 35 videos a month. Monthly plans can be cancelled anytime. Monthly credits expire when the billing period ends; Impulse Pack credits never expire.
